Gonzalez maximin from several starting indices at once

Source: R/farfirst.R
dot-MaximinMulti.Rd

Ensemble counterpart of .MaximinFrom() / .MaximinFromPoints(): solves one greedy pass per seed. Each pass is an independent function of its seed, so under mc.cores > 1 the passes run concurrently, one per thread; a lone seed, or a problem large enough for a single pass to occupy every thread itself, falls back to the per-pass parallelism instead.

Usage

.MaximinMulti(k, firsts, d = NULL, points = NULL)

Arguments

k

Integer: target subsample size (>= 1).

firsts

Integer vector of distinct first-selected indices, one per pass.

d

Square pairwise distance matrix, or NULL when points is given.

points

A double N x dim coordinate matrix, or NULL.

Value

.MaximinMulti() returns a list with one list(idx, tK) per element of firsts, in that order.
